name: notification-stack
title: Notification Stack
description: A short pile of notification cards showing app, message and time, with a count and a Show all toggle. Hovering fans them into a list, and swiping one or pressing its corner cross removes it.
use: A dashboard or inbox should show a few recent alerts without taking up a full panel.
avoid: Hover is the main way to expand it, so on touch the pile stays collapsed until you tap the header.
a11y: Strong coverage: cards expand on focus, Delete removes them, and focus moves on to the next card. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A header row with Notifications, a count and a Show all link above stacked white rounded cards, each with a coloured app icon, a bold title, a grey body line and a time. Collapsed, the cards behind peek out as thin strips.
behaves: Hovering or focusing fans the pile into a full list and the header flips to Show less. Dragging the front card sideways follows the pointer and, past a short distance or a quick flick, throws it off the edge while the rest close the gap.
customise: Pass a notifications array of app, title, body, time and icon, and handle removals with onDismiss; the peek, gap and swipe thresholds are constants in the source.
weight: light: A handful of cards with a per-card requestAnimationFrame only during a swipe.
demo: Four alerts: a message from Maya Chen, a design review, a paid invoice and a Blue Bottle card payment.
issues: Frame 5 catches the dismissed card as a faint red smear on the right that looks like a glitch.
Behind the front card the others show only a thin strip, so the pile's depth is easy to miss.
polishWhy: Convincing fan and fling physics with clean cards; the collapsed pile hides its depth.
